findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizing bleach to be available during inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer was purchased from a nearby Dollar General. Sanitizer solution was remade and tested at 100 ppm CL.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no handwashing to be set up upon arrival, Discussed with PIC, hand washing was being done at church nearby. A temporary hand washing station was prepared. Ensure hand washing is available on site.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

(REPEAT) Observed no signed employee health reporting agreements. CFPM and PIC, Rev. Melissa, should review and sign the document. Discussed with PIC. Provided copy for facility. Inspector will follow-up on 10/25/21. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 2/10/21.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-102.11(C)(2) (Pf) PIC does not demonstrate the responsibility of preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by employees that may cause food borne disease. Discussed related section of the food code.  Reference 2-102.11(C)(2).

Observed facility to lack signed employee health reporting agreements. Provided new paperwork and highlighted importance of document. Inspector will follow-up on 2/20/20.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11  (Pf) Establishment does not have procedures for employees to follow when responding to discharging of vomitus or fecal matter. Provide procedures to comply with this section of the code. Reference 2-501.11.

Observed facility to lack a policy for Norovirus illness clean-up. Provided paperwork for facility. COS.
